requirements.appearance: M03 rounded forms. User message and composer surfaces match orb's current hue. Assistant replies remain light neutral. No shared backdrop.
requirements.orb: Perfect circle, internal vapor animates. At any instant exactly one hue family, with tonal variation; global hue changes over time rather than simultaneous multicolor.
requirements.synchronization: Orb, user messages, composer change hue together.
requirements.dragging: User can grab orb with mouse to move the entire overlay.
requirements.windowLayer: Always on top of other application windows.
requirements.idle: Only small orb visible until activated.
requirements.platforms: Broad desktop audience. Omarchy initial environment, macOS later.
requirements.implementationStatus: Static design concepts only. Animation, dragging and window layering are requirements, not implemented.
